name: hcapp_setFcmTokens
description: Updates the Apple Push Notification (APNS) and Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) tokens for the calling device. Called after the OS grants or refreshes notification permissions. @apnsToken is NULL for Android devices.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Used as the auth lookup key and the UPDATE target.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic token validated by HC6.ValidateAppAuth against the device secret.

parameters.name: apnsToken
parameters.description: Apple Push Notification Service token. NULL for Android devices. Matches Device.ApnsToken NVARCHAR(500) NULL.

parameters.name: fcmToken
parameters.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging token. NULL if not yet available. Matches Device.FcmToken NVARCHAR(500) NULL.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Always returned as the first rowset. success=1 on success; success=0 with errorCode and errorType populated on any error (auth failure, or unhandled DB error).

columns.name: success
columns.description: 1 if the operation succeeded; 0 on any error path.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: NULL on success. Populated error code on failure (auth or DB error).

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: NULL on success. HC6 error type code on failure: 11=auth, 19=db.

rowsets.name: ErrorDetail
rowsets.description: Returned as the second rowset only when success=0. Contains structured error detail for the caller.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: GUID of the HC.ErrorLog entry created for this error.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Error code forwarded from ValidateAppAuth, or 1915 from the CATCH block.

columns.name: errorTitle
columns.description: Short error title. 'Unexpected error' from the CATCH block path.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Device SET ApnsToken = @apnsToken, FcmToken = @fcmToken WHERE id = @deviceId
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on auth failure (via ValidateAppAuth) and on unhandled CATCH block error

codeSmells.detail: Line 84: SET @errorCode = 1915 is an undocumented magic value with no explanation. If this is a composed code (19=errorType, 15=spNumber), that convention is not consistent with other SPs and should be documented or replaced with a standard sentinel.

codeSmells.issue: HcVersion hardcoded as '<unknown>' in ErrorLog INSERT
codeSmells.detail: Line 86: INSERT HC.ErrorLog uses HcVersion = '<unknown>'. If the schema has a mechanism to pass the app version, this should be populated. If not, document why it is always unknown on this path.

The UPDATE at line 71 does not verify @@ROWCOUNT = 1 after completing. If the deviceId does not match any row, the SP silently succeeds with success=1. HC5 at least returned 'Failed' when @@ROWCOUNT != 1. Consider asserting @@ROWCOUNT = 1 and returning a not-found error if the device no longer exists.

breakingChanges: Success rowset shape changed: HC5 returned a single 'result' column (NVARCHAR 'Success'/'Failed'); HC6 returns a structured envelope with success (BIT), errorCode (INT), errorType (INT). All callers must be updated.

Error rowsets restructured: HC5 returned HC5-style standard error columns (errorId, errorType, errorTitle, errorUserMessage, debugMessage, errorProc); HC6 returns the two-rowset pattern (envelope + ErrorDetail). The 'debugMessage' column is no longer present in HC6 error detail.
TRY/CATCH added: HC5 had no error handling; unhandled SQL errors now return success=0 with errorCode/errorType rather than propagating an unhandled exception to the caller.
Auth delegated to HC6.ValidateAppAuth: HC5 used CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2 directly; HC6 delegates to the shared ValidateAppAuth helper, which may have different token validation semantics.
